description: Machine-readable inventory of performance audit checks for validation and generated maps.

statusTaxonomy.present: The expected invariant is fully satisfied.
statusTaxonomy.partial: Most signals resolve, with a small number of exceptions, or the codebase shows mixed adherence to a soft check.

enrichmentFlags.description: Enrich findings with Lighthouse metrics from a results file, cross-validating the LCP element and Core Web Vitals.

relatedAudits.relationship: Owns bundle-size budgets; this audit owns runtime and rendering cost.
Owns correctness-driven memoization; this audit owns performance-driven memoization.

checks.title: Expensive computations memoized
checks.expectation: Expensive derivations inside component bodies are wrapped in useMemo or moved out of render.
checks.violationSignal: A known-expensive method at the top level of a render function with non-trivial inputs and no useMemo wrapping.

checks.title: Stable references for memo'd children's props
checks.expectation: Components wrapped in React.memo receive object, array, or function props that are stable across renders.
checks.violationSignal: An inline object literal or arrow function passed to a React.memo-wrapped child as a prop.

checks.title: Stable Context values
checks.expectation: Context provider values are wrapped in useMemo so consumers do not re-render on every parent render.
checks.violationSignal: A Context.Provider with a fresh object literal as its value each render.

checks.title: Long lists virtualized
checks.expectation: Lists rendering more than the threshold of repeating items use a virtualization library.
checks.violationSignal: A .map rendering more items than the threshold without a virtualization wrapper.

checks.title: Stable list keys
checks.expectation: List keys are stable, unique, and not the array index when items can be inserted, removed, or reordered.
checks.violationSignal: key={index} patterns in lists where the data shape suggests reordering is possible.

checks.title: React.memo for pure components in hot paths
checks.expectation: Pure components rendered many times per parent render are wrapped in React.memo.
checks.violationSignal: Frequently-rendered pure components without React.memo wrapping.

checks.title: No expensive work in render without memoization
checks.expectation: Render bodies do not synchronously perform large transformations without useMemo.
checks.violationSignal: Detected hot patterns running unconditionally in render bodies.

checks.title: useState lazy initialiser for heavy initial values
checks.expectation: Expensive initial values use the lazy initialiser form of useState.
checks.violationSignal: useState(expensiveCompute()) with a non-trivial right-hand side that runs on every render.

checks.title: Single data-fetching strategy
checks.expectation: Exactly one data-fetching strategy is used, not multiple in the same application.
checks.violationSignal: Two or more strategies present in dependencies and used in source.

checks.title: Stale-time configured
checks.expectation: The detected data layer has a non-zero default staleTime or equivalent.
checks.violationSignal: A default staleTime of 0 in the global query client configuration.

checks.title: Parallel fetches use parallel patterns
checks.expectation: Multiple independent fetches in the same render path use parallel patterns rather than sequential await chains.
checks.violationSignal: Sequentially awaited fetches with no data dependency between them.

checks.title: No N+1 fetch patterns
checks.expectation: Lists do not fire one fetch per row from inside list items.
checks.violationSignal: A useQuery or equivalent called inside a list item's render path.

checks.title: Request deduplication available
checks.expectation: The detected data layer deduplicates concurrent requests for the same key.
checks.violationSignal: A custom data layer with no deduplication.

checks.title: Prefetching for predictable navigation
checks.expectation: Links to known navigation targets prefetch.
checks.violationSignal: Custom anchor-based navigation in apps where the data layer supports prefetching.

checks.title: Streaming and Suspense for slow data
checks.expectation: Long-loading data sections are wrapped in Suspense boundaries with meaningful fallbacks.
checks.violationSignal: Slow data fetches in route handlers or server components that block the entire route render.
checks.skipWhenAbsent: The project is not on the Next.js App Router.

checks.title: Server-rendered data not re-fetched on client
checks.expectation: Data already available from a server component, route loader, or initial server render is not re-fetched on the client.
checks.violationSignal: Patterns where server-rendered data is also fetched via a client-side hook.

checks.title: Framework image primitive used
checks.expectation: Images use the framework's image component; native img is reserved for icon-sized SVG and decorative purposes.
checks.violationSignal: Plain img tags pointing at content imagery in a framework that provides an image primitive.

checks.title: LCP image marked priority
checks.expectation: At least one image per landing route is marked as the priority or eager-loaded LCP candidate.
checks.violationSignal: No priority or eager-loaded image on landing routes, or the hero image is not the priority one.

checks.title: Explicit dimensions on images
checks.expectation: Every image has explicit width and height, or CSS aspect-ratio, to avoid Cumulative Layout Shift.
checks.violationSignal: An image with no dimensions and no aspect-ratio CSS.

checks.title: Lazy loading below-the-fold images
checks.expectation: Below-the-fold images use lazy loading.
checks.violationSignal: Forced eager loading on below-the-fold imagery.

checks.title: Fonts use font-display swap or optional
checks.expectation: Web fonts are configured with font-display: swap or optional, with critical fonts preloaded.
checks.violationSignal: Fonts loaded without font-display, or with font-display: block.

checks.title: Critical CSS handled
checks.expectation: The framework handles critical CSS extraction, or the project explicitly inlines critical CSS for hero and landing routes.
checks.violationSignal: Neither path is set up.

checks.title: No layout-shifting late content
checks.expectation: Content that loads asynchronously has reserved space so it does not push other content when it arrives.
checks.violationSignal: Async-loading content with no reserved dimensions.

checks.title: Video autoplay is muted
checks.expectation: video autoplay is paired with muted.
checks.violationSignal: Autoplay videos without muted.

checks.title: Long computations deferred or workered
checks.expectation: Computations that visibly block the main thread use useDeferredValue, startTransition, requestIdleCallback, or a Web Worker.
checks.violationSignal: Detected hot patterns running synchronously in event handlers or effects.

checks.title: Scroll, resize, and mousemove handlers throttled
checks.expectation: High-frequency event handlers are debounced or throttled.
checks.violationSignal: Scroll or equivalent handlers firing without throttling.

checks.title: Animations use compositor-friendly properties
checks.expectation: Animations change transform, opacity, or filter rather than layout properties.
checks.violationSignal: CSS or JS-driven animations that touch layout properties such as width, height, top, left, or margin.

checks.title: Web Vitals reporting integrated
checks.expectation: The project reports Web Vitals to a backend.
checks.violationSignal: No Web Vitals reporting detected.

checks.title: Real User Monitoring integrated
checks.expectation: A Real User Monitoring provider is configured for production.
checks.violationSignal: No Real User Monitoring detected.

checks.title: Lighthouse CI configured
checks.expectation: Lighthouse CI runs in continuous integration with thresholds for performance score and Core Web Vitals.
checks.violationSignal: No Lighthouse CI configuration detected.

checks.title: Performance budgets defined and enforced
checks.expectation: The project enforces budgets on Lighthouse-derived metrics and continuous integration fails the build when they regress.
checks.violationSignal: No metric budgets defined, or defined but not enforced.
